behavior: A tab activates at the `click` of a pointer press and at Enter and Space. With `activateOnFocus`, it also activates at a key of the list that moves the focus: an arrow key, Home or End. A focus that a pointer press or a script gives activates no tab. A press that leaves the tab before the release gives the tab no `click`, and a press of the secondary button gives no `click`, so neither activates a tab. With `activateOnFocus`, Base UI activates a tab at its focus event, except during a press of the secondary button. So in Base UI, a press of the primary button activates the tab before the release.
